title: Epics with overlapping infrastructure files should be merged or given explicit file ownership
description: Epic 1 (Infrastructure Foundation) and Epic 2 (Tech Stack Standards) both modify Dockerfiles, docker-compose files, CI workflows, and pyproject.toml configs. The phase manifest itself recommended merging them. Running separate agent teams on these epics will produce guaranteed merge conflicts on shared files.
root_cause: Phase 1.2 (Form Epic Candidates) treats Infrastructure and Tech Stack as separate domains and forms separate epics, even when the manifest suggests merging. The command does not check for file-level overlap between candidate epics based on whitebox/bootstrap context.
recommendation: In Phase 1.2, after forming epic candidates, add a file-overlap detection step: for each pair of candidate epics, check if their features reference the same infrastructure files (Dockerfiles, docker-compose, CI workflows, pyproject.toml). If overlap exceeds a threshold (e.g., 3+ shared files), recommend merging or require explicit file ownership boundaries before proceeding.
initiative_context: Janus Communication Surveillance Platform, Phase 1, 35 features, 5 epics
